resultsProcessor.script: var bytes = context.bytes(); var pairId = 'malformed-pair'; var idBytes = bytes.createFromString(pairId); var digest = bytes.sha256(idBytes); var fileName = bytes.binaryToHex(digest) + '.pair.json'; bytes.release([idBytes, digest]); context.files('storage-root').write(fileName, '{not-json'); var response = context.sendToStep('accept-storage', JSON.stringify({ operation: 'getPair', pairId: pairId, publicRecordId: 'public', secretRecordId: 'secret', includeSecret: false })); if (response.isErrored()) throw new Error(response.getAllErrors()[0]); var result = JSON.parse(response.getBody()); if (result.status !== 'not-found') throw new Error('expected malformed pair to produce safe not-found outcome'); context.sendMetric('storage-malformed-record-pass', 1.0);
